notes.title: Our new game + developer community links
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a bit since our last big update here -- we hope all has been well! We're back now with two bits of news.

1- If you're interesting in chatting it up with us, we've now got a Discord. We've got some new stuff cooking and we'll be sharing news, WIP art and videos, etc in our newly formed [url=discord.gg/MdbVSc2NyE]Robot Invader Discord server[/url]. We'll also be doing the occasional game giveaway and such there. If a newsletter or Twitter is more your thing, we're got those too. So if you're interesting in learning more about our previous games (we have 10!) and being the first to get info and opportunities to playtetst our next one (we're actively working on it!), plus game giveaways, we'd love for you to join our community. Here are the links:
[list]
[*] [url=discord.gg/MdbVSc2NyE]Robot Invader Discord server[/url]
[*] [url=robotinvader.com/newsletter/ ]Robot Invader Newsletter[/url] (promise, no spam!)
[*] [url=https://x.com/robotinvader]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

2- our latest game SEEING THINGS recently launched! Woohoo!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636340/SEEING_THINGS/utm_source=DSC_communityupdate][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12663215/e74d964983935be9cf5a6368a433a8c28792c4f1.png[/img][/url]

It's been a lot of fun seeing players and streamers alike enjoying[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636340/SEEING_THINGS/utm_source=DSC_communityupdate] SEEING THINGS[/url]. It's currently sitting at 100% positive reviews. And if it sounds like it's your thing --it's got the perfect blend of silly and spooky -- we'd love for you to check it out too!

notes.title: Monster REMASTER Update!
notes.content:
DEAD SECRET CIRCLE just got a [b]Mega Remaster Update[/b]. We spent the last two years going over the game with a fine tooth comb to make it the best it can be. Included in this update:
[list]
[*]Completely reworked visuals for the entire game. New shaders, new lighting, new effects, new sequences.
[*]Key scenes and story beats updated and improved based on player feedback.
[*]Completely new character rendering system with shadows, normal maps, eye glints, and more
[*]Huge number of bug fixes and polish items.
[/list]
Check out some of the new shots below. If you haven’t checked out DEAD SECRET CIRCLE at all or it’s been some time, now is a stellar time. And right in time for Halloween!
